"""Freeze the clean committed baseline and its already-qualified release libraries."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import tarfile

ROOT = Path.cwd()
D = ROOT / '.local/parser-copy-20261004'
PRIOR = ROOT / '.local/output-copy-20261004'

def sha(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()

def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))

def save(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')

assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain']).strip(), 'Dirty baseline'
base = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']).decode().strip()
assert base == 'ef3f13ae9a597d280137fd71dd486eacc4076371'
compiled = read(PRIOR / 'source-identity.json')
assert all(sha(ROOT / name) == digest for name, digest in compiled['files'].items())
link = read(PRIOR / 'identity-serialization-after.json')
for name, digest in link['libraryHashes'].items():
    assert sha(ROOT / name) == digest, name
paths = sorted(set(subprocess.check_output(
    ['git', 'ls-files', '--cached', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '-z']
).decode().split('\0')) - {''})
files = {name: sha(ROOT / name) for name in paths if (ROOT / name).is_file()}
save(D / 'before-source-identity.json', {'base_commit': base, 'files': files})
with tarfile.open(D / 'before-source.tar', 'w') as archive:
    for name in files:
        info = archive.gettarinfo(str(ROOT / name), arcname=name)
        if name.endswith('.sh'):
            info.mode = 0o755
        with (ROOT / name).open('rb') as stream:
            archive.addfile(info, stream)
libraries = {}
for source in sorted((ROOT / 'target/release/deps').glob('*.rlib')) + [
    ROOT / 'target/release/libpine_runtime.rlib',
    ROOT / 'target/release/libpine_sema.rlib',
    ROOT / 'target/release/libpine_syntax.rlib',
]:
    relative = source.relative_to(ROOT / 'target/release')
    target = D / 'baseline' / relative
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    digest = sha(source)
    shutil.copy2(source, target)
    assert sha(target) == digest
    libraries[str(source.relative_to(ROOT))] = {'archive': str(target), 'sha256': digest}
assert all(sha(ROOT / name) == digest for name, digest in files.items())
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain']).strip()
save(D / 'before-binary-identity.json', {
    'baseCommit': base,
    'beforeManifestSha256': sha(D / 'before-source-identity.json'),
    'beforeArchiveSha256': sha(D / 'before-source.tar'),
    'compiledPriorManifest': str(PRIOR / 'source-identity.json'),
    'compiledPriorManifestSha256': sha(PRIOR / 'source-identity.json'),
    'compiledPriorFiles': len(compiled['files']),
    'compiledPriorIsUnchangedSubsetOfBaseline': True,
    'priorLinkReceipt': str(PRIOR / 'identity-serialization-after.json'),
    'priorLinkReceiptSha256': sha(PRIOR / 'identity-serialization-after.json'),
    'libraries': libraries,
    'method': 'All baseline rlibs copied before production edits or builds; primary libraries match prior audited final link',
})
print('Frozen', len(files), 'baseline files and', len(libraries), 'release libraries at', base)

"""Bind a concrete validation/build/link invocation to frozen source before and after."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,sys,subprocess,time
from evidence_common import D,ROOT,sha,read,save

def verify():
    manifest=read(D/'source-identity.json')
    changed=[p for p,h in manifest['files'].items() if not (ROOT/p).is_file() or sha(ROOT/p)!=h]
    if changed: raise ValueError('Source changed: '+repr(changed))
    return {'manifestSha256':sha(D/'source-identity.json'),'archiveSha256':sha(D/'source.tar'),
            'files':len(manifest['files']),'sourceVerified':True}

def main():
    name=sys.argv[1];command=sys.argv[2:]; assert command
    before=verify(); entry={'phase':name,'command':command,'before':before,'startedUnixSeconds':time.time(),
                            'wrapperSha256':sha(Path(__file__)),'status':'running'}
    path=D/f'phase-{name}.json';assert not path.exists(),path
    save(path,entry)
    with (D/f'phase-{name}-wrapper.log').open('wb') as log:
        completed=subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    entry.update(returncode=completed.returncode,finishedUnixSeconds=time.time(),
                 wrapperLogSha256=sha(D/f'phase-{name}-wrapper.log'))
    after=verify(); assert before==after
    entry.update(after=after,status='passed' if completed.returncode==0 else 'failed')
    if name.startswith('gate-'):
        (D/(name+'.exit')).write_text(str(completed.returncode),encoding='utf8')
        gate_log=D/(name+'.log')
        entry.update(gateLogSha256=sha(gate_log) if gate_log.exists() else None,
                     gateExitSha256=sha(D/(name+'.exit')))
    elif name=='release':
        entry.update(buildLogSha256=sha(D/'build-release.log'),buildExitSha256=sha(D/'build-release.exit'))
    elif name.startswith('link-'):
        _,probe,tag=name.split('-');entry.update(linkReceiptSha256=sha(D/f'identity-{probe}-{tag}.json'),
            linkLogSha256=sha(D/f'link-{probe}-{tag}.log'))
    save(path,entry); print(name,entry['status'],'frozen files',before['files'],flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(completed.returncode)

if __name__=='__main__':main()

def process_run(run, command, directory, stem):
    fields(run, {"command", "returncode", "wallSeconds", "stdout", "stdoutSha256", "stderr", "stderrSha256", "exit", "exitSha256"}, "Run")
    require(run["command"] == command and run["returncode"] == 0, "Subprocess command/exit differs")

    for key, suffix in (("stdout", ".stdout"), ("stderr", ".stderr"), ("exit", ".exit.json")):
        expected = directory / (stem + suffix)
        require(same_path(run[key], expected) and sha(expected) == run[key + "Sha256"], "Subprocess artifact identity differs: " + key)

def sample(pattern, index):
    return {
        "ordinary": lambda: 100.25 + (index % 17) / 16.0,
        "mixed": lambda: [0.125, -17.75, 1e20, -1e20, 1e-20, -1e-20, float.fromhex("0x1p-1022"), float.fromhex("0x1.fffffffffffffp+1023"), 1.0000000000000002, -0.0][index % 10],
        "extreme": lambda: 1e308, "subnormal": lambda: 1e-310,
        "negative_zero": lambda: -0.0,
        "nonfinite": lambda: [float("nan"), float("inf"), -float("inf"), -0.0, 1.5][index % 5],
        "records": lambda: [1e308, -1e308, 1e-310, -0.0, 17.25, float("nan")][index % 6],
        "gradient": lambda: [17.25, float.fromhex("0x1.fffffffffffffp+1023"), 1e-310, -0.0, float("nan")][index % 5],
    }[pattern]()


class Proof:
    def __init__(self):
        self.finite = self.nulls = self.negative = self.digest = 0

    def number(self, actual, expected):
        if math.isfinite(expected):
            require(actual is not None and bits(actual) == bits(expected), "Direct input float bits changed")
            value_bits = bits(expected)
            self.finite += 1
            self.negative += value_bits == (1 << 63)
            self.digest = ((self.digest * 1099511628211) & ((1 << 64) - 1)) ^ value_bits
        else:
            require(actual is None, "Nonfinite direct input is not JSON null")
            self.nulls += 1

    def document(self):
        return {"finiteFloatBitsChecked": self.finite, "nonfiniteNullsChecked": self.nulls,
                "negativeZeroBitsChecked": self.negative, "inputBitsFnv64": f"{self.digest:016x}"}


def gradient(values, pattern, count, proof):
    require(isinstance(values, list) and len(values) == count, "Gradient fixture length differs")
    for index, entry in enumerate(values):
        fields(entry, {"topValue", "bottomValue", "topColor", "bottomColor"}, "Gradient sample")
        for name, expected in (("topValue", sample(pattern, index)), ("bottomValue", sample(pattern, index + 1))):
            if math.isfinite(expected):
                proof.number(entry[name], expected)
            else:
                require(entry[name] is None, "Absent gradient float changed")
        require(entry["topColor"] == (0xff0000ff if index % 2 == 0 else None), "Gradient top color differs")
        require(entry["bottomColor"] == (0x00ff00ff if index % 3 == 0 else None), "Gradient bottom color differs")

    expected_diag = [{"code": "E_PROBE", "message": "\0\n\t汉🙂"}] if delta else []

def fixture_proof(document, pattern, count, delta=False):
    proof = Proof()
    if delta:
        fields(document, DELTA_TOP | ({"strategy"} if pattern == "records" else set()), "Delta fixture root")
        require({key: document[key] for key in ("schemaVersion", "revision", "baseRevision", "retainedFrom", "visibility")} ==
                {"schemaVersion": 4, "revision": 2, "baseRevision": 1, "retainedFrom": 0, "visibility": "preview"}, "Delta fixture header differs")
        require(len(document["series"]) == 1, "Delta plot count differs")
        plot = document["series"][0]
        fields(plot, {"family", "id", "op", "start", "values"}, "Delta plot")
        require({key: plot[key] for key in ("family", "id", "op", "start")} ==
                {"family": "plot", "id": 1, "op": "append", "start": 0}, "Delta plot fields differ")
        for family in ("hlines", "alerts", "diagnostics"):
            require(document[family] == [], "Unexpected delta family: " + family)
    else:
        fields(document, FULL_TOP | ({"strategy"} if pattern == "records" else set()), "Full fixture root")
        require(document["schemaVersion"] == 9 and document["renderMetadataVersion"] == 1, "Full fixture schema differs")
        for family in EMPTY_FAMILIES:
            require(document[family] == [], "Unexpected full family: " + family)
        require(len(document["plots"]) == 1, "Full plot count differs")
        plot = document["plots"][0]
        fields(plot, {"id", "values"}, "Full plot")
        require(plot["id"] == 1, "Plot fixture ID differs")
        require(document["diagnostics"] == ([{"code": "E_PROBE", "message": "\0\n\t汉🙂"}] if pattern == "records" else []), "Diagnostic fixture differs")
    require(isinstance(plot["values"], list) and len(plot["values"]) == count, "Plot fixture length differs")
    for index, actual in enumerate(plot["values"]):
        proof.number(actual, sample(pattern, index))
    if pattern == "gradient":
        require(len(document["fills"]) == 1, "Gradient fill fixture count differs")
        fill = document["fills"][0]
        if delta:
            fields(fill, {"id", "action", "start", "values"}, "Gradient delta")
            require(fill["id"] == 3 and fill["action"] == "setGradient" and fill["start"] == 0, "Gradient delta fields differ")
            gradient(fill["values"], pattern, count, proof)
        else:
            fields(fill, set("id firstId secondId firstIsHLine secondIsHLine colors gradient title".split()), "Gradient fill")
            require(fill["id"] == 3 and fill["firstId"] == fill["secondId"] == 1 and
                    fill["firstIsHLine"] is False and fill["secondIsHLine"] is False and fill["title"] == "gradient\n汉🙂", "Gradient fill fields differ")
            require(fill["colors"] == [None] * count, "Gradient masking colors differ")
            gradient(fill["gradient"], pattern, count, proof)
    else:
        require(document["fills"] == [], "Unexpected fills")
    drawing_name = "drawings" if delta else "lines"
    if pattern == "records":
        require(len(document[drawing_name]) == 1, "Records line fixture count differs")
        if delta:
            drawing = document["drawings"][0]
            fields(drawing, {"family", "id", "action", "start", "object"}, "Drawing delta")
            require({key: drawing[key] for key in ("family", "id", "action", "start")} ==
                    {"family": "line", "id": 2, "action": "setTail", "start": 0}, "Drawing delta fixture differs")
        records_channels(document, pattern, count, proof, delta)
    else:
        require(document[drawing_name] == [], "Unexpected drawing fixture")
    return proof.document()


def serial_metrics(document, scenario, count):
    fields(document, SERIAL_TOP, "Serialization metric root")
    require(document["schemaVersion"] == 1 and document["scenario"] == scenario and document["bars"] == count, "Serialization case identity differs")
    require(document["manualFixture"] is (scenario in {"negative_zero", "nonfinite", "records", "gradient"}), "Manual fixture classification differs")
    require(document["deltaFixture"] == DELTA_SCOPE and document["parserOutcomesCount"] == 36, "Serialization scope/corpus differs")
    fields(document["stages"], STAGES, "Serialization stages")
    for stage, values in document["stages"].items():
        fields(values, METRICS, "Stage " + stage)
        for metric, value in values.items():
            numeric(value, stage + "/" + metric, metric != "liveDeltaBytes")
            if metric != "ms":
                integer(value, stage + "/" + metric)
    # Counter holds no output buffer. Wrapper and iterator work can still
    # allocate, so retain the measured counters without assuming zero heaps.
    if document["manualFixture"]:
        require(all(document["stages"]["seed"][metric] == 0 for metric in METRICS - {"ms"}), "Manual fixture seed did real allocation work")
    fields(document["sinkWriteCalls"], {"owned", "view", "delta"}, "Sink write counts")
    require(all(integer(value, "Sink write calls") > 0 for value in document["sinkWriteCalls"].values()), "Missing sink work")
    fields(document["byteEquality"], {"ownedView", "ownedString", "viewString", "consumedString", "deltaString"}, "Encoder byte equality")
    require(all(value is True for value in document["byteEquality"].values()), "Encoder byte equality failed")
    for key in ("fullProof", "deltaProof"):
        fields(document[key], PROOF_KEYS, key)
    return document


def behavior_corpus(document):

    require(document["schemaVersion"] == 1 and len(document["cases"]) == 36, "Parser corpus case count differs")
    text = (D / "serialization_probe.rs").read_text(encoding="utf8")

    require(arrays is not None, "Probe parser corpus declarations missing")
    inputs = [(parser, json.loads(token)) for parser, block in zip(("full", "delta"), arrays.groups())
              for token in re.findall(r'^\s*("(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"),\s*$', block, re.M)]
    require(len(inputs) == 36, "Static parser corpus input count differs")
    gradient_unknown = "invalid gradient sample: unknown field `extra`, expected one of `topValue`, `bottomValue`, `topColor`, `bottomColor`"
    full_errors = [
        "runtime result must be JSON: EOF while parsing a value at line 1 column 0",
        "runtime result must be JSON: EOF while parsing a list at line 1 column 1",
        *(["runtime result must be a JSON object"] * 5), None,
        "plots must be a list", "plot entry must be an object", "`id` must be an integer",
        "unsupported object Pine value", "strategy must be an object", "missing or invalid `code`", None,
        "gradient fill requires runtime schema 9", 'invalid gradient sample: invalid type: string "x", expected f64',
        "invalid gradient sample: invalid value: integer `-1`, expected u64", gradient_unknown,
        "gradient sample requires topValue", "gradient sample count must match fill colors",
    ]
    delta_errors = [
        "runtime changes must be JSON: EOF while parsing a value at line 1 column 0",
        "runtime changes must be JSON: EOF while parsing a list at line 1 column 1",

        "unsupported series op `other`", None, "invalid gradient sample: invalid type: boolean `true`, expected f64", gradient_unknown,
    ]
    errors = full_errors + delta_errors
    require(len(errors) == len(inputs), "Independent behavior expectations incomplete")
    successes = 0
    for row, (parser, input_text), error in zip(document["cases"], inputs, errors):
        fields(row, {"parser", "input", "outcome"}, "Parser case")
        require(row["parser"] == parser and row["input"] == input_text, "Parser input/order differs")
        outcome = row["outcome"]
        if error is not None:
            require(outcome == {"success": False, "error": error}, "Parser error bytes differ")
        else:
            fields(outcome, {"success", "canonicalJson"}, "Successful parser case")
            require(outcome["success"] is True, "Successful parser case failed")
            canonical = loads(outcome["canonicalJson"])
            if input_text == "{}":
                expected = {key: [] for key in FULL_TOP - {"schemaVersion", "renderMetadataVersion"}}
                expected.update(schemaVersion=9, renderMetadataVersion=1)
            elif parser == "full":
                expected = {key: [] for key in FULL_TOP - {"schemaVersion", "renderMetadataVersion"}}
                expected.update(schemaVersion=9, renderMetadataVersion=1,
                                plots=[{"id": 1, "values": [-0.0, 1e-310, 1e308, None]}])
            else:

                expected.update(schemaVersion=2, revision=2, baseRevision=1, retainedFrom=0, visibility="confirmed",
                                series=[{"family": "plot", "id": 1, "op": "append", "start": 0, "values": [-0.0, 1e-310, 1e308, None]}])
            equivalent(canonical, expected)
            successes += 1
    require(successes == 3, "Parser success case count differs")


def raw_serial_row(row, case, directory, identities, calibration=False):
    name, scenario, count = case
    tag = "before" if calibration else row["tag"]
    stem = scenario if calibration else f'{name}-{tag}-{row["repetition"]}'
    rawdir = directory / stem
    source = D / "serialization-source.pine"
    command = [identities[tag]["binary"], scenario, str(count), str(source), str(rawdir)]
    metrics = serial_metrics(process_run(row["run"], command, directory, stem), scenario, count)
    equivalent(metrics, row["metrics"])
    fields(row["rawJson"], RAW_FILES, "Raw serialization paths")
    documents, digests = {}, {}
    for kind, filename in RAW_FILES.items():
        path, reference = rawdir / filename, row["rawJson"][kind]
        fields(reference, {"path", "sha256"} if calibration else {"path", "sha256", "bytes"}, "Raw file reference")
        require(same_path(reference["path"], path) and sha(path) == reference["sha256"], "Raw JSON path/hash differs")
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        if not calibration:
            require(len(raw) == integer(reference["bytes"], "Raw bytes"), "Raw file reference byte count differs")
        if kind != "parserOutcomes":
            require(len(raw) == integer(metrics[kind + "Bytes"], "Metrics bytes"), "Measured/public JSON byte count differs")
        documents[kind], digests[kind] = loads(raw), sha(path)
    for original, public, is_delta in (("full", "publicFull", False), ("delta", "publicDelta", True)):
        expected = fixture_proof(documents[original], scenario, count, is_delta)
        require(expected == metrics["deltaProof" if is_delta else "fullProof"], "Raw direct-input FNV/count proof differs")
        require(fixture_proof(documents[public], scenario, count, is_delta) == expected, "Public reencode changed direct bits")
        require((rawdir / RAW_FILES[original]).read_bytes() == (rawdir / RAW_FILES[public]).read_bytes(), "Fixture/public reencoding bytes differ")
    behavior_corpus(documents["parserOutcomes"])
    return {"case": name, "tag": tag, "repetition": None if calibration else row["repetition"],
            "metrics": metrics, "rawSha256": digests, "rawDirectory": str(rawdir)}
